_doc: Marketplace live-simulation scenarios. GENERATED by tools/build_marketplace_sim_scenarios.py — edit the generator, never this file, so coverage stays auditable by dimension rather than by whoever last had an idea.

steps: sign in as a seller with >=1 listing
land on the Listings tab
wait for all boot loads
scenarios.assert: #content-area shows the seller's LISTINGS, never another tab's empty state
scenarios.why: a shared render target means last-writer-wins; the tab that owns the surface must be the only one to paint it

steps: open Services
read the grid and the services pane
scenarios.assert: exactly ONE of #listing-grid / #services-pane is displayed, never both
scenarios.why: [hidden] loses to any explicit display, so a 'hidden' element stays on screen

steps: visit the seller dashboard SIGNED OUT
focus #edit-title
scenarios.assert: focus does NOT land on the hidden edit form; the sheet carries [inert]
scenarios.why: opacity:0 hides from eyes only; the subtree stays in the tab order and the a11y tree

steps: open Services
read the service picker options
scenarios.assert: cert-gated options carry data-cert, sourced from the truth VIEW not the base table
scenarios.why: a truth view does not inherit new base columns, so the client reads undefined

steps: hail via the real form WITH a pin
read the row back
confirm a NEAR provider is inside the radius and a FAR one is excluded
scenarios.assert: service_requests.location is NOT NULL and st_dwithin actually discriminates by distance
scenarios.why: seeded rows carry data the real form never captures, so a broken filter looks like it works

steps: open any listing detail
measure the Contact Seller button
scenarios.assert: the primary CTA is within the viewport without scrolling (sticky action row)
scenarios.why: the only path to transact sits below the fold with nothing suggesting it exists

steps: be below the deposit floor
attempt to accept a job
scenarios.assert: the refusal names the REAL balance and the REAL floor, never 'negative' when positive
scenarios.why: a threshold moved and its message did not, so the refusal states something false

steps: cold-load the founder console
wait 7s without touching anything
scenarios.assert: the credit-economy tile populates on its OWN, with no manual invocation
scenarios.why: a loader exists and works when invoked, and nothing calls it on a real page load
